T: Riddle me this. What's for dinner.
D: Batman takes on the Riddler and Two-Face while taking in a young circus acrobat named Dick Grayson.
P: Serve the snacks when the Flying Graysons take to the trapeze at the circus.
S: the circus where the Flying Graysons perform
Popcorn tossed with melted butter and a little caramel, poured into red and white striped cones.
Two kinds of slider, one beef with cheddar and one chicken with slaw, served side by side.
Soft pretzels twisted into question marks, salted and served with mustard. Roll 500g pizza dough into 8 ropes and shape each into a question mark with a dot.
M: Beef eye fillet roasted to medium-rare with a red wine sauce, potato gratin and asparagus.
Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, capsicum and a sticky sweet chilli sauce, served in takeaway boxes.
W: the trapeze act at the circus
Batter piped in swirls into hot oil, fried golden, dusted with icing sugar and served with berries.
K: Lime cordial and lemonade with a scoop of vanilla ice cream floating on top.

s.note: the circus where the Flying Graysons perform
s.how: Pop 100g popping corn in a large lidded pot. Melt 50g butter with 50g brown sugar until bubbling and toss through the popcorn with a pinch of sea salt flakes. Spread out to cool for 5 minutes, then pour into red and white striped paper cones.

Roll 500g pizza dough into 8 ropes and shape each into a question mark with a dot. Dip in 1L water simmering with 3 tbsp bicarb soda for 20 seconds, sprinkle with salt flakes and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with mustard.

m.how: Stir-fry 500g sliced chicken thighs in a hot wok until browned. Add a sliced red capsicum and cook for 2 minutes. Toss through 400g cooked egg noodles with 4 tbsp sweet chilli sauce and 2 tbsp soy sauce until sticky, then pack into takeaway boxes.

w.note: the trapeze act at the circus
w.how: Whisk 200g flour, 2 eggs, 250ml milk and a spoon of sugar into a smooth batter. Pipe in looping swirls into 180C oil and fry until golden on both sides. Drain on paper, dust thickly with icing sugar and serve warm with sliced strawberries.

d.how: Pour a splash of lime cordial into each tall glass and top up with cold lemonade. Gently add a scoop of vanilla ice cream so it floats and fizzes up green. Serve straight away with a long spoon and a straw before the foam spills over.
